jobs.title: Vice President, Communication & PR
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleNightingale College is looking for a Vice President, Communications & PR to join our executive leadership team and lead the strategy behind how we tell our story — to the public, to our own community, and to the learners and alumni whose lives we're helping change.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Nightingale College is looking for a Vice President, Communications & PR to join our executive leadership team and lead the strategy behind how we tell our story — to the public, to our own community, and to the learners and alumni whose lives we're helping change. Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, you'll hold executive-level accountability for our Communications division, which spans three distinct audiences: PR & External Publications, Corporate Communications, and Learner & Alumni Communications.

As Nightingale scales toward 20,000 learners by 2028, this role owns the communications infrastructure that will carry us there. You'll set the vision, empower three directors to lead their respective audiences with real ownership, and make sure everything we say — externally and internally — is cohesive, purposeful, and unmistakably Nightingale.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Communications Strategy

  • Architect a cohesive enterprise communications strategy across all three audience functions, while preserving what makes each one distinct
  • Ensure all communications across the organization advance Nightingale's Purpose and align to the Core 7 framework
  • Serve as the senior communications voice on the executive leadership team, representing the division in strategic planning and to external stakeholders

PR & External Publications

  • Guide the Director of PR & External Publications in building brand awareness and positive sentiment among the public, nurse leaders, and state boards of nursing
  • Ensure Nightingale's distance learning model and commitment to non-traditional learners is represented accurately and compellingly in every state and region we operate
  • Provide strategic oversight on media relations, earned media, and crisis communications
  • Serve as a regulatory communications steward, ensuring external communications account for accreditation and governing body implications

Corporate Communications

  • Guide the Director of Corporate Communications in building a system-wide strategy that unites all Collaborators around Nightingale's growth goals
  • Ensure internal communications continuously reinforce Core 7 connection, Evolvitude™, and Collaborator fulfillment in purpose
  • Oversee communications support for the executive team and Collaborator Experience function, keeping Collaborators informed of organizational direction and programs

Learner & Alumni Communications

  • Guide the Director of Learner & Alumni Communications in building a comprehensive strategy across the full learner journey — from enrollment through LPN → ASN/RN → BSN → MSN (Nurse Practitioner)
  • Ensure operational communications are accurate, timely, and regionally tailored to each enrolled population
  • Support learner progression and continuation goals through intentional, journey-mapped communications

Measurement & Accountability

  • Build and maintain a VP-level KPI dashboard consolidating performance across all three director-led functions
  • Report regularly to the CGO on the health and strategic effectiveness of enterprise-wide communications

What You Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive communications leadership, including demonstrated experience at the VP or executive level
  • Master's degree required
  • Demonstrated understanding of higher education communications
  • Proven track record owning budget accountability for a communications function in a growth-stage organization
  • Experience leading simultaneous multi-audience communications strategies with full hiring and resource authority
  • Strong data fluency — able to build, interpret, and present KPI-based performance frameworks
  • Executive presence — able to operate as a peer within an executive leadership team and represent the organization externally

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of accreditation processes and state board of nursing regulatory environments
  • Familiarity with higher education and non-traditional learner populations
  • Background in change communications and organizational culture alignment

Why Nightingale

At Nightingale, communications isn't a support function tucked in a corner — it's how we hold our high-impact community together and share our story with the world. As VP, you'll shape how nurse leaders and state boards see us, how our own Collaborators feel connected to our Purpose, and how learners experience their journey from enrollment through advanced practice. This is a rare opportunity to sit at the executive table and lead communications strategy that's directly tied to real people building careers in nursing — all while championing Evolvitude™ and the Core 7 framework that defines who we are.

Budgeted Hiring Range
$187,000—$204,000 USD

All new hires are required to attend New Collaborator Orientation (NCO) in Salt Lake City, Utah. The College will cover travel, lodging, and other accommodations.

Nightingale’s commitment to diversity and inclusion is reflected both in our learners and collaborators because we believe the best outcomes for learners from underserved and diverse populations are achieved through collaborators with similar backgrounds and cultures. Nightingale Education Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Our Mission (not just words on the wall, we live it, love it, and daily contribute to it): With the primary focus on higher learning in healthcare professions, Nightingale Education Group contributes to elevating education, health, and employment systems through facilitation of academic achievement, personal growth, and professional development of its learners, alumni, and collaborators, while serving diverse communities.

At Nightingale Education Group, our Innovative Education model helps transform rural health landscapes through our blended-distance learning platform. Every person involved with Nightingale Education Group helps to change the lives of our learners, our communities, and ultimately the world by adding to the quality of healthcare. We are proud to have graduated nearly 5,000 nurses serving communities in need. We are serious about our outcomes and have a little bit of fun getting there.

The professional and personal development of our learners and our collaborators is our company’s foundation. Not only do we develop strategies that promote a positive work-life integration, but we also create an environment that invites you to become an expert in your field, be it through higher education or professional development. Put simply, we elevate employment, elevate health, and elevate education. We’re so happy that you’ve found us!

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Platforms & AI
jobs.excerpt: About the Role We're looking for a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to own the technical security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and AI-driven systems.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to own the technical security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and AI-driven systems. You'll spend most of your time in the systems themselves: hardening infrastructure, closing vulnerabilities, and building the guardrails that keep our AI-driven workflows safe.

Following our recent Series A, we're scaling rapidly and investing deeply in platform security, AI safety, and operational resilience. This is a builder's role, not a policy role. You'll work closely with Engineering to secure production systems, find weaknesses, and keep our monitoring and incident response sharp as we scale.

As a remote-first company, we welcome applicants based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

You'll join a high-ownership, high-trust engineering culture where self-starters thrive and autonomy is the natural state of work.

Key Responsibilities

Security Engineering & System Hardening
  • Secure and harden cloud infrastructure, applications, APIs, internal systems, and operational workflows.
  • Implement and maintain security controls across production environments, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and internal tooling.
  • Work directly with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Ensure encryption, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and access controls are properly implemented and continuously maintained.
  • Design and improve security architecture across cloud-native and distributed systems.
  • Build scalable security processes that integrate directly into engineering and operational workflows.

Vulnerability Management & Offensive Security
  • Continuously identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across infrastructure, applications, APIs, and operational systems.
  • Proactively search for weaknesses through vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, adversarial testing, threat modeling, and manual security reviews.
  • Coordinate remediation efforts across engineering and operations teams, and validate fixes to ensure long-term mitigation.
  • Improve detection and prevention capabilities for emerging threats.
  • Help establish a culture of continuous security improvement and operational accountability.

AI Security & Emerging Threat Protection
  • Secure AI-driven systems and automated agents against prompt injection, adversarial inputs, unauthorized or unintended actions, unsafe outputs, and data leakage.
  • Design and implement guardrails and validation layers for AI-generated actions.
  • Ensure AI systems safely handle untrusted inputs from IVRs, web systems, APIs, and human interactions.
  • Monitor AI system behavior for anomalies, abuse attempts, or unsafe decision-making.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure AI systems are observable, auditable, bounded, and fail safely.
  • Help define operational and technical controls for responsible AI deployment.

Monitoring, Detection & Incident Response
  • Improve and maintain security monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response capabilities.
  • Investigate suspicious activity, anomalies, and potential security incidents.
  • Lead or support incident response efforts, root cause analysis, and remediation planning.
  • Ensure operational visibility into system health, access patterns, and security events.
  • Recommend and implement preventative measures following incidents or security discoveries.

Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, application security, DevSecOps, or offensive security.
  • Exceptional knowledge of the AWS ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and remediating vulnerabilities in live production systems.
  • Self-starter mindset: able to drive projects, make decisions, and prioritize ruthlessly in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security issues clearly to engineering stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience securing AI/LLM-powered systems or automated agents.
  • Familiarity with prompt injection attacks, adversarial AI techniques, AI guardrails, and behavioral anomaly detection.
  • Experience with cloud security tooling, SIEM and observability platforms, penetration testing tools, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure-as-code security.
  • Prior experience in high-growth startup, fintech, banking, or payments environments.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty, or similar.

What We Offer
  • 100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in the US or Canada)
  • Competitive salary and equity opportunities
  • Unlimited PTO, flexible schedule, and paid holidays
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • A culture built on ownership, transparency, autonomy, and craftsmanship
  • Real opportunities for architecture ownership and technical leadership

jobs.excerpt: Join a team committed to a mission!  At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success.
jobs.description:
Join a team committed to a mission!

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Are you ready for your next career challenge?

The Defense Sector of Leidos has a career opportunity for a talented Quality Manager (QM) to support multiple programs on a single contract vehicle in the Decision Advantage Business Area. This position serves as a member of a team with the responsibility to ensure quality service is provided to customers through the generation and control of program processes, performance of internal process audits and consistent facilitation of structured improvement activities.

The contract vehicle emphasizes Quality Manager – Program Manager partnership and a risk-based quality approach tailored to the needs of each specific program. The environment demands the ability to quickly establish cross-functional and cross-organizational working relationships with diverse coworkers and customers.

A successful Quality Manager can (1) articulate how their quality control, improvement, and management strategies will support the Program Manager’s proactive control of schedule, cost, suppliers, and customer satisfaction, and (2) demonstrate with evidence that their tactical implementation of their Quality Management System (QMS) has effectively supported those goals.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Integrated QMS Development and implementation

  • Collaborate with program teams to design, implement, and execute a QMS
  • Define the QMS in program Quality Assurance Plans (QAP)/Quality Control Plans (QCP)
  • Lead development and implementation of streamlined QMS processes aligned to program execution risk, schedule, and priority

Deliverables Management

  • Support development of program deliverables tracking and on-time delivery (OTD) management
  • Review contract deliverables prior to delivery
  • Support development of peer/technical review processes and metrics collection
  • Monitor and collect metrics on OTD

Performance Measure Monitoring

  • Support program leadership in identifying and defining meaningful program performance measures (including contractual Service Level Agreements, Leidos internal required measures, and program-defined measures)
  • Support development and implementation of a monitoring program for these measures

Structured Process Improvement

  • Support programs in developing and maintaining a continuous improvement program
  • Recommend, facilitate, track and report on continuous process improvement activities
  • Utilize industry standard methodologies to lead structured continuous process improvement efforts
  • Evidence with metrics and data that completed improvement activities were effective

Internal Auditing, Root Cause Analysis facilitation, and Corrective Action Support

  • Develop and execute a risk-based audit plan to ensure compliance (with PWS, QASP, EENG, Leidos policy)
  • Support programs in efficiently and effectively addressing corrective and preventive action (CAPA) for non-compliance and opportunities for improvement where best practices are not in place
  • Facilitate no-fault root cause analysis investigations with program staff using standard tools (5-Why, Ishikawa Diagram, Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA), Pareto charting, chronological/process diagram)

Reporting, Communications, and Escalation

  • Provide the PM with regular briefings (performance metrics performance, audit reports, continuous improvement project status and achievements) to support situational awareness and execution reporting
  • Collaborate with the contract vehicle QM to support vehicle initiatives and priorities at the program level
  • Support Leidos reporting, such as Quality Management Reviews, In Process Reviews, Weekly Activity Reports, and Monthly Operational Reviews
  • Report to higher level management on Quality Achievement and act as liaison for enterprise quality initiatives for the program
  • Report mandatory program metrics and performance data to Mission Assurance (OTD, Award Fee scores, CPARS)
  • Escalate performance concerns and performance-related contract actions to Mission Assurance

Other duties as required

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BA/BS degree and 4 or more years of relevant experience or Masters with 2or m ore years of prior relevant experience
  • Must have an Active DoD Secret security clearance
  • Experience supporting Software Development Projects (in QA/QC or another capacity).
  • Experience with Agile Principles
  • Experience leading process or continuous improvement programs or initiatives using standard methodologies and tools (Lean, Six Sigma, LSS, PDCA, TQM, Kaizen, 5S)
  • Experience with peer reviews
  • Experience with process auditing
  • Experience defining, collecting and analyzing metrics
  • Ability to multi-task, complete tasks without direct supervision, and function in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent verbal and written skills
  • Proficiency with Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Confluence)
  • Proficiency with MS Office products and collaborative tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams)
  • Ability to support limited domestic travel
  • At least 1 year of 100% remote work experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience supporting Hardware Assembly/Integration Projects (in QA/QC or another capacity).
  • Experience auditing to external quality standards such as ISO9001/ISO20000/AS9100/CMMI Dev or Svc
  • Lean Six-Sigma Green Belt
  • Certified Lean Six-Sigma Black Belt
  • Formal auditor training or certification
  • Experience with GSA and/or Department of War-administered contracts
  • Experience with MS Power Automate

DABAOPP1

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.excerpt: Vestmark is seeking a VP, Product Management to own the strategy and roadmap for the portfolio management capabilities within the Vestmark platform and more specifically Vestmark VAST.
jobs.description:
Vestmark is seeking a VP, Product Management to own the strategy and roadmap for the portfolio management capabilities within the Vestmark platform and more specifically Vestmark VAST. VAST is Vestmark's direct indexing and tax-aware portfolio management platform, built to deliver "Personalized Investing at Scale." Managed by Vestmark Advisory Solutions (VAS), VAST combines a proprietary risk-based optimization engine with a rules-driven alerts and trading workflow to personalize and tax-manage thousands of accounts.

This is a subject-matter-expert role: you will be the definitive product voice and decision-maker for how Vestmark's multi-sleeve, multi-manager portfolio construction, trading, and rebalancing tools work — and how those capabilities get delivered to the wealth management channel (broker-dealers, RIAs, TAMPs, and bank trust programs) as well as the asset managers and overlay managers who operate within them.

The ideal candidate has built quantitative portfolio management technology solutions for asset managers and deeply understands how UMA sleeve structures, overlay trading, tax management, and rebalancing engines work in practice. You know the difference between sleeve-level performance attribution and household-level asset location rebalancing, you understand trading discretion at the account vs. sleeve level, and you can translate that operational fluency into a platform roadmap that scales across dozens of sponsor programs and thousands of accounts.

You will partner closely with engineering and client delivery to design and ship systems that Portfolio Managers want to use, while ensuring those solutions are commercially viable and configurable for Vestmark's wealth management sponsor clients. Given the natural overlap between this role's product surface and Vestmark Advisory Solutions' (VAS) own portfolio management team, you will maintain a strong working relationship with VAS leadership to ensure the roadmap reflects real, day-to-day portfolio management needs.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for UMA, SMA, and multi-sleeve portfolio construction, overlay trading, and rebalancing capabilities across the VAST platform.
  • Translate the operational realities of Portfolio Management — trading discretion, sleeve vs. account-level rebalancing, cash coordination across sleeves, tax overlay management, composite/performance attribution — into clear, prioritized product requirements
  • Act as the internal subject-matter authority on UMA structures (sleeves, base sleeves, overlay managers, manager-traded sleeves, flexible/custom models) and how they intersect with household-level asset location rebalancing
  • Partner with engineering and design to architect scalable solutions that serve both large wirehouse/broker-dealer UMA programs and asset manager/overlay manager workflows
  • Work directly with Portfolio Managers, overlay managers, and asset manager partners (both internal at VAS and external sponsor-side clients) to gather requirements and validate solutions before and after delivery
  • Maintain a strong relationship with the Advisory Solutions (VAS) organization, ensuring the product roadmap reflects the needs of Vestmark's own Portfolio Management team as a proving ground for the broader wealth channel
  • Define and prioritize the backlog for your product area, balancing strategic platform investments against client-specific and regulatory-driven commitments
  • Represent Vestmark's UMA and portfolio management capabilities in client and prospect conversations, RFPs, and executive business reviews
  • Partner with Sales, Relationship Management, and Client Delivery to ensure new and existing wealth management clients can successfully adopt and scale on the platform
  • Stay current on industry trends in managed accounts, direct indexing, tax management, and multi-manager portfolio construction, and translate them into platform investment decisions
  • Contribute to the growth and development of our core values: We Before Me, Positive Energy, Knowledge Explorer, and Own It

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, portfolio management, or investment technology roles within the wealth management or asset management industry

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart’s Strategic Finance team partners closely with leaders across the business to drive clarity, rigor, and results. Within this group, the Retailer Pod supports our retailer partnerships by shaping deal strategy, building robust financial models, and guiding decisions that help Instacart and our partners grow together.

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to accelerate retailer deal flow and portfolio performance. You will join a high-impact, collaborative pod within Strategic Finance, working daily with Retail Partnerships, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Data Science, and Accounting. In this role, you’ll own end-to-end financial analysis for complex commercial deals, build scalable forecasting frameworks, and present actionable insights that influence decisions at the highest levels.

This is an opportunity to roll up your sleeves in a fast-paced, evolving environment, bring structure to ambiguity, and make a visible impact on Instacart’s growth. You’ll help us go far together by pairing analytical depth with crisp storytelling that moves the business forward.

About the Job

  • Own end-to-end financial modeling for retailer partnerships, including pricing strategies, incentive structures, unit economics, and ROI analyses with scenario and sensitivity testing.
  • Partner with Retail Partnerships and Deal Desk to translate strategy into clear financial outcomes; support negotiations with data-driven recommendations and crisp trade-off frameworks.
  • Build and maintain driver-based forecasts for a portfolio of retailer deals; establish KPIs, track performance vs. plan, and surface insights that improve margin and payback.
  • Design and standardize scalable templates, playbooks, and dashboards that streamline diligence, approval, and post-close performance management.
  • Create executive-ready materials—models, memos, and presentations—that distill complex analyses into clear narratives and decisions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Science, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and Legal to ensure operational feasibility, policy alignment, and accurate financial treatment.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting supporting commercial deals or growth initiatives in technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, or retail.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel/Google Sheets, including driver-based models, cohort and retention analysis, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.
  • Proficiency in SQL for self-serve analysis and experience with a BI tool (e.g., Looker or Tableau).
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating or structuring commercial partnerships or contracts (pricing, unit economics, and ROI modeling) and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketplace or retailer/CPG partnerships and multi-sided platform economics.
  • Hands-on collaboration with Sales/Partnerships and Legal on deal terms (e.g., volume commitments, incentives, performance SLAs).
  • Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (e.g., ASC 606) and how contract structures impact financial treatment.
  • Experience building dashboards in Looker/Tableau and automating workflows with SQL or Python.
  • MBA, CFA, or CPA.

We're hiring a Paid Media Manager to own Google Ads and Meta Ads strategy and execution across the client portfolio. You will personally manage campaigns for 40+ local service businesses simultaneously, with monthly ad budgets typically ranging from $1,000 to $10,000 per client. You will be directly accountable for lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rate, and return on ad spend.

This is a hands-on, in-the-accounts role. Daily optimization, weekly testing, monthly reporting, and ongoing collaboration with account managers and the content team are the rhythm of the job. The agency works on plain-language client communication — you will be expected to translate dashboard data into outcomes business owners actually care about.

The role reports to the Director of Marketing / Agency Principal and operates fully remote on a Monday–Friday schedule aligned to US Mountain Time business hours.

Responsibilities

Google Ads

  • Build, launch, and optimize Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns for local service businesses
  • Conduct ongoing keyword research and disciplined negative keyword management to maximize budget efficiency
  • Write conversion-focused ad copy with strong CTAs oriented toward calls and form fills, not click volume
  • Set up and manage conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

  • Build remarketing audiences and run RLSA campaigns to re-engage high-intent prospects
  • Maintain the agency's 10%+ Google Ads conversion rate standard across all assigned accounts

Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)

  • Develop audience strategies using Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, and interest/behavioral targeting
  • Brief the content team on creative requirements — images, video, carousels — that convert for local service businesses
  • Run structured A/B tests on creative, copy, audience segments, and placements
  • Set up and maintain Meta Pixel and Conversions API for accurate attribution
  • Manage daily and lifetime budgets and optimize delivery toward CPL targets
  • Apply Advantage+ campaigns where appropriate while maintaining manual control over key accounts

Reporting & Client Communication

  • Build and maintain monthly performance reports using the agency dashboard, GA4, and CallRail
  • Translate performance data into plain-English insights — what worked, what didn't, what's next
  • Present results in monthly client review calls alongside the assigned account manager
  • Flag underperforming campaigns proactively to internal stakeholders, never at month-end

Strategy & Collaboration

  • Contribute to new client onboarding by recommending starting budgets, platform mix, and campaign structure
  • Identify upsell opportunities in existing accounts (e.g., adding retargeting, platform expansion)
  • Stay current on Google Ads and Meta Ads platform changes and surface new strategies to the team
  • Collaborate with SEO and content teams to ensure paid and organic strategies reinforce each other

Requirements

Requirements

  • 2–5 years of hands-on paid media experience managing both Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns in a paid role
  • Demonstrated experience managing 10+ client accounts simultaneously, with agency experience strongly preferred
  • Strong command of Google Ads: Search, Display, Performance Max, Smart Campaigns, and remarketing
  • Solid Meta Ads experience covering campaign structure, audience targeting, creative testing, and lead generation forms
  • Working proficiency in GA4 and Google Tag Manager for conversion tracking setup and troubleshooting
  • Practical experience configuring and debugging Meta Pixel and Conversions API
  • Comfort with CallRail or a comparable call tracking platform
  • Analytical fluency — the ability to read a dashboard and identify what to change without prompting
  • Clear, direct written and verbal English communication
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet and the ability to overlap with US Mountain Time business hours

Nice to Have

  • Google Ads certification (Search, Display)
  • Meta Blueprint certification
  • Direct experience running paid media for home services, HVAC, contractors, or local service businesses
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM and lead management workflows

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Remote-first work environment with a US-based team

How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a brief cover note that addresses both of the following:

jobs.title: Mergers and Acquisitions Manager [Remote USA]
jobs.excerpt: Build deals.  Build relationships.  Help build our US business.
jobs.description:
Build deals. Build relationships. Help build our US business.

Celnor Group is entering an exciting new phase of international growth, and we're looking for an experienced M&A Manager to play a central role in building our US platform.
The United States is an important part of Celnor's long-term growth strategy. We have ambitious plans and are looking for someone on the ground who can identify exceptional businesses, build genuine relationships with their owners, and lead transactions from initial opportunity through to completion.
This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a pipeline or coordinate advisors.
We're looking for someone who can find opportunities, understand businesses, build relationships, and get deals done.
You'll be based remotely in the United States, working closely with our established M&A leadership in the UK while taking significant ownership of activity across our priority US markets, including the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, North Carolina, Texas, and California.

What you'll be doing:

You'll take genuine ownership within our US acquisition pipeline, working across multiple opportunities at different stages and helping Celnor identify businesses that are both commercially attractive and culturally right for our Group.
You'll be responsible for:
  • Identifying and originating acquisition opportunities, including off-market opportunities
  • Building trusted relationships directly with founders, owners, and entrepreneurs
  • Assessing businesses from financial, strategic, and commercial perspectives
  • Developing investment cases and recommendations for senior leadership and the Board
  • Leading transactions through evaluation, due diligence, negotiation, and completion
  • Building financial analysis and deal models in Excel
  • Producing clear, high-quality investment papers, reports, and presentations
  • Coordinating external advisors and internal stakeholders throughout the transaction process
  • Working closely with Finance, HR, Integration, and operational leadership
  • Managing multiple live transactions while maintaining pace, accuracy, and attention to detail
  • Contributing ideas, market intelligence, and potential opportunities to our wider US acquisition strategy

This is deliberately a hands-on M&A role. We want someone who enjoys being close to the transaction and wants to personally drive deals rather than oversee the process from a distance.

What we're looking for:

Fundamentally, we need someone who already knows how to do deals.

You may currently be working in corporate development, lower-middle-market M&A, investment banking, or transaction advisory. We're less concerned with the name above the door and more interested in what you've actually done.

You'll ideally bring:
  • A strong track record of executing and leading M&A transactions
  • Experience working within the lower-middle market
  • Strong financial analysis and transaction capability
  • Excellent commercial judgment and the ability to recognize what makes a genuinely attractive business
  • Confidence building relationships directly with founders and business owners
  • The ability to originate opportunities rather than relying solely on intermediated processes
  • Strong Excel financial modeling and PowerPoint skills
  • The ability to turn complex financial and commercial information into clear recommendations
  • Confidence presenting investment cases to senior stakeholders
  • The judgment to assess cultural alignment alongside financial performance
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to operate autonomously while remaining part of an internationally connected team
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the United States as required

A CPA, CFA, or equivalent professional finance/accounting qualification would be advantageous.
Experience combining M&A with consulting, corporate strategy, or another commercially focused environment would also be valuable.

The person behind the resume matters

We're building something ambitious, but we're not trying to recreate an investment bank.
Our team moves quickly. Decisions get made. People are trusted to take ownership, challenge thinking, and get things done.
You'll need to be confident, commercially curious, and comfortable speaking with everyone from entrepreneurs and advisors to senior executives and Board members.
We're looking for someone with integrity, energy, judgment, and a sense of humor. Someone who communicates openly, notices things others miss, brings ideas to the table, and isn't afraid to get into the detail when a transaction needs it.
You'll also need to be comfortable operating independently. Your closest colleagues may be across the Atlantic, so we're looking for someone who doesn't need constant direction to create momentum.
There will inevitably be intense periods around transactions, but we also believe high performance and having a life outside work can coexist. We're not interested in creating an investment banking culture where long hours are treated as a badge of honor. We respect personal and family time while recognizing that, occasionally, everyone needs to get into the trenches to get a deal over the line.

Why Celnor?

Celnor Group is a rapidly growing group of specialist businesses operating across the Testing, Inspection, Certification, and Compliance (TICC) sector.
Our model is deliberately different.
We acquire successful specialist businesses and give their leaders access to the investment, expertise, and support of a larger international group while protecting the entrepreneurial culture, technical expertise, and identity that made those businesses successful in the first place.
That means our approach to M&A is about more than the numbers.
Many of the people you'll meet have spent years building their businesses. Understanding what matters to them, earning their trust, and recognizing whether there is a genuine cultural fit with Celnor is just as important as understanding the financials.
Our US strategy represents an important next stage of our growth.
You'll be joining early enough to have a genuine influence over how that story develops, working closely with senior Group leadership while having the autonomy to build relationships, create opportunities, and make things happen in the US market.
And as our US platform grows, so could your role.
For the right person, there is the potential to help build and ultimately lead a broader US M&A capability over time.

Compensation & benefits:
  • Base salary: $140,000–$160,000
  • On-target earnings: Deal-based variable incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is performance-related, is not guaranteed, and is subject to the applicable incentive plan.
  • Location: Remote, United States
  • Travel: Domestic travel required, typically around twice per month depending on deal activity.
  • Benefits: Competitive US benefits package, including healthcare coverage and a generous paid time off allowance.

....

Additional Information:

Celnor Group is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based on the requirements of the role and individual qualifications, without discrimination on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

OVERVIEW

ABC Fitness powers the operators shaping the future of the fitness industry. As Enterprise Director, Strategic Accounts, you will own and grow our Top 100 prospects globally for ABC Fitness, studio, and enterprise operator relationships across North America and EMEA.

Reporting to the VP, Global Sales, you will build a data-backed territory strategy, create executive-level pipeline, and personally advance complex, high-value sales cycles from first conversation through signature. This is a hands-on enterprise sales role with significant cross-functional influence: you will lead a dedicated enterprise pod through strategy, prioritization, and operating cadence, while partnering with Marketing, Solutions, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Product, Legal, and Finance to win and expand strategic accounts.

Success in this role means creating demand, building executive consensus, improving forecast discipline, and landing durable enterprise relationships that support ABC’s growth and customer impact.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and continuously refine a territory plan for top strategic gym and studio accounts, prioritizing opportunities by fit, propensity, expansion potential, and enterprise value.
  • Create qualified enterprise pipeline through account-based outreach, executive networking, event-driven engagement, and disciplined follow-up across priority accounts.
  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through signature, including executive alignment, business-case development, procurement navigation, negotiation, and mutual action planning.

  • Bring structured customer, competitive, and commercial insight back to Product, Pricing, Customer Success, and Sales leadership to strengthen ABC’s enterprise go-to-market motion.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Experience in B2B software or SaaS sales with a strong focus on enterprise, multi-stakeholder, and high-complexity commercial cycles.
  • A demonstrated record of personally closing large enterprise opportunities, including deals with senior executive sponsors including c-suite leaders, finance, procurement, operations, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to build territory strategy from a blank page, translate strategy into pipeline coverage, and operate with disciplined weekly and quarterly execution.
  • Strong command of value-based selling, executive discovery, account mapping, mutual action planning, negotiation, and commercial risk management.
  • Ability to reframe buyer thinking, create urgency, and help customers move through indecision in long, consensus-driven enterprise sales cycles.
  • Proven skill orchestrating cross-functional resources across Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, and executive leadership.
  • Experience leading work through influence, including coordinating SDRs, solution advisors, sales engineers, specialists, or other pod resources who may not report directly to you.
  • High ownership of CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy, deal documentation, and operating rigor.

AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE

  • Fitness, wellness, payments, vertical SaaS, or multi-location operator experience.
  • Experience selling into centralized and franchised operating models across multiple regions or countries.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales frameworks such as MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, or JOLT.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing on executive events, account-based campaigns, or strategic customer experiences.
  • Comfort operating across North America and EMEA time zones

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Enterprise ARR performance is on track against quota, with a healthy mix of net-new strategic wins and expansion across priority accounts.
  • The top-account territory plan is clear, data-backed, and consistently translated into pipeline creation, executive engagement, and close-plan execution.
  • Strategic opportunities are well-qualified, multi-threaded, forecastable, and supported by aligned internal resources.
  • The enterprise pod is operating with clear priorities, strong accountability, and visible contribution to pipeline quality and deal progression.
  • ABC gains sharper customer and market insight from your account work, improving product feedback, pricing input, customer references, and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

We’re committed to diversity and passion, and encourage you to apply even if you do not tick every listed skillset.

We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, clients, and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and make authentic connections. ABC leaders believe that an equitable and inclusive culture is not only the right thing to do, it is a business imperative.

ABC Fitness is the premier provider of software and related services for the fitness industry and has built a reputation for excellence in support for clubs and their members. ABC is a trusted provider helping club operators improve performance and create a total fitness experience for members across multi-location chains, franchises, independent gyms, studios, and other fitness businesses.

Founded in 1981, ABC helps gyms and health clubs globally perform better and more profitably through comprehensive SaaS club management solutions. ABC Fitness is a Thoma Bravo portfolio company, a private equity firm focused on investing in software and technology companies.

$140,000 - $145,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
  • Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com

Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. The Office of Sponsored Programs (OSP), within the Office of Research & Innovation (ORI), provides leadership in grants and contracts administration throughout the lifecycle of awards by working closely with diverse university faculty and compliance offices to ensure the responsible stewardship of external funding. Reporting to the Director, Contracts and Subawards, the Lead Subaward Officer is responsible for processing, negotiating, issuing, and tracking different types of outgoing subawards such as a) Cost Reimbursement, b) Fixed Fee, c) Fixed Fee Clinical Trials, d) Subcontracts, etc., to U.S. based and non-U.S. based organizations for externally funded grants and contracts from federal and non-federal sponsors. This position will routinely work with university partners, including Principal Investigators, Department Administrators, external collaborators, OSP Staff, the Office of General Counsel, Risk Management, Applied Innovation, and Research Compliance to manage, draft, and issue subawards, including modifications to active subawards.

Essential Functions

  • Identify, define, and resolve issues related to sponsored project subcontracting activities.
  • Support Drexel's research community in the administration of subawards under externally and internally funded sponsored projects, providing expertise and customer service. Utilize and maintain systems and procedures related to subawards processing.
  • Consult with the Director of Contracts and Subawards or its designee regarding issues and solutions.

  • Advise, assist, and train faculty and other study personnel about policies, procedures, forms, laws, and regulations related to university subaward agreements.
  • Advise, assist, and train the Subaward Officers within OSP.

    • Ability to work as a member of a large, complex support team.

    • Must have good interpersonal skills; must be a good communicator.

Location

This individual influences functional and portfolio decisions through operational expertise, identifies and mitigates regulatory documentation risks, and builds organizational capabilities that enable successful global submissions and lifecycle management.

WHO WE ARE

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to .

Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).

Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic.

The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale.

Loyalty Product Mission

Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs.

Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering.

The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain.

Scope of Ownership

Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to:

  • Customizable loyalty programs
  • Configurable reward rules
  • Flexible tiering structure
  • Reward points tracking
  • Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks
  • Omnichannel support
  • Unified ZMP Identity

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions.

  • Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation.
  • Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation.
  • Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes.

  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening.
  • Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Onboarding and Compliance Risk Strategy team serves as a key risk management function that partners with product, engineering, and cross-functional teams to bring products to market safely and responsibly. Our work spans money movement, money storage, lending, and emerging product areas including embedded finance, stablecoin settlement, and digital assets — requiring fluency in both traditional financial regulation and the compliance obligations unique to fintech-native products. We are seeking a strategic-minded and collaborative Risk professional to build and scale the risk management and compliance foundations for our Financial Account products, our new and existing credit products, and the global payment networks that power them.

What you’ll do

Stripe is building new products that expand the scope of problems we tackle beyond payments and into the rest of the financial stack. Right now this includes Capital, Financial Accounts, and Issuing - and there's more on the way. Stripe is a technology company that operates within the financial services industry, and you will need to be comfortable straddling both of those worlds every day. The right person for this role will thrive while working at the intersection of an emerging sector and a traditional industry, seek creative solutions to traditional problems, and enable the business responsibly while moving with urgency and focus. We are currently hiring for two roles, one with a focus on lending products and another with the focus on global payment networks. If you have experience with either and meet the below qualifications, please apply!

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and 2LOD teams to design and implement data-driven, risk-based KYC/KYB frameworks — including CIP, CDD, EDD, beneficial ownership, identity verification, and automated decisioning logic — that balance onboarding conversion, user friction, and compliance requirements across Financial Account, Capital, and Issuing products.
  • Design risk-tiered onboarding standards and progressive KYC/KYB frameworks that optimize conversion rates while maintaining appropriate controls; define risk acceptance criteria, gating logic, and escalation pathways for edge cases, manual review, and policy exceptions.
  • Design and document compliant, scalable funds flow models for global payment networks (e.g., SEPA, FPS, ACH, RTP), translating complex network rules into technical requirements for engineering teams.
  • Develop and maintain technical compliance documentation, translating complex regulatory requirements (e.g., U.S. lending laws, payment network rules) into actionable guidance for product and engineering teams.
  • Manage relationships and drive alignment across a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders, including Legal, Customer Support, Partnerships, and 2LOD Compliance, ensuring all voices are heard and decisions are made effectively.
  • Engage directly with external financial partners, presenting Stripe's compliance controls and strategy to build trust and confidence.
  • Extend your expertise to new regions and payment schemes, quickly learning new regulatory and technical landscapes to enable Stripe's international expansion.
  • Utilize data to inform risk strategy, compliance solutions, and decision-making by sourcing and analyzing product and user data to measure control effectiveness.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5 years of professional experience in compliance, product risk, technical compliance, audit, or similar risk roles at a FinTech, payment provider, or bank.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing risk-based KYC and KYB programs for business or merchant onboarding.
  • Proven experience working at a technical level with product managers and engineers, with an ability to design solutions and write technical requirements documentation.
  • Demonstrated success in managing complex projects with numerous cross-functional stakeholders, driving consensus, and managing expectations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging directly with external partners and instilling confidence.
  • Experience sourcing and using data to analyze problems, inform strategic decisions, and measure control effectiveness.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous situations and operate efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, high-volume, and technology-driven environment.
  • Respect for and interest in financial rules and regulations, as well as an eagerness to innovate and drive the financial technology industry forward.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep experience with U.S. financial regulations impacting lending compliance and/or financial crimes OR a strong technical and operational understanding of payment network funds flows and scheme rules for major rails such as SEPA, FPS (UK), ACH (US), and RTP (US), including cross-border payments compliance and state money transmission requirements.
  • Experience designing or advising on compliance frameworks for embedded finance, Banking as a Service (BaaS), or platform/Connect models where partners control downstream user experiences and Stripe must enforce standards at scale.
  • Proficiency with SQL for sourcing and analyzing data.
  • Proficiency using AI tools to automate document writing, assist in research and analysis and support recommendations.
  • Familiarity with digital assets, cryptocurrency, and stablecoin-based payment and settlement flows, and the associated compliance obligations — including virtual asset service provider (VASP) frameworks, on-chain/off-chain transaction risk, and emerging regulatory developments such as the GENIUS Act and MiCA.
  • Experience applying regional compliance expertise to new markets.

Job Description Summary



This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager.

As the Manager, Operational Controls, you will lead a team of Operational Controls Analysts responsible for the day-to-day execution, quality, and consistency of operational control monitoring across Novartis Patient Support programs. You will execute approved monitoring strategy and control frameworks into reliable, scalable execution, while supporting analyst capability and ensuring monitoring outputs are accurate, consistent, and escalated through established governance pathways.
This role executes monitoring activities and the delivery/escalation of control insights. It does not own corrective action remediation, agent coaching, or end-to-end process redesign; those activities are managed through defined partner teams and governance.

Job Description

Major Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day execution of operational control monitoring across assigned teams and programs, ensuring operational targets are met for Operational Controls Analysts.
    • Ensure monitoring adheres to approved frameworks, scoring logic, definitions, standard work, and calibration routines to maintain consistency.
    • Apply control definitions consistently while accounting for program context without drifting from standards.
    • Manage monitoring volume, cadence, and depth based on operational risk, channel, and lifecycle stage; adjust staffing and focus during hypercare/launch periods.
    • Directly manage and develop Operational Controls Analysts through clear expectations, prioritization, performance standards, onboarding, ongoing skill development, and coaching on monitoring accuracy, judgment, and consistency.
    • Support team resilience through intentional cross-training across programs and monitoring functions while protecting required specialization and maintaining monitoring responsibilities.
    • Enforce clear boundaries between monitoring, remediation, coaching, and training; prevent scope creep and reinforce documented decision rights and escalation paths.
    • Conduct first-level quality checks; prepare and submit escalation inputs for governance forums and partner teams, while partnering with the Associate Director to ensure monitoring readiness for new programs, channels, and operational changes, with all activities aligned to Associate Director direction.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree required. MBA or other graduate degree a plus

Required Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience leading operational, quality, audit, or monitoring teams in a complex environment.
    • Experience in patient services or similar environments (including specialty pharmacy distribution & capabilities, patient care coordination, operational workflows,
    and managed care knowledge).
    • Demonstrated people leadership, coaching, and performance management capability.
    • Experience operating within regulated and/or risk-based frameworks, with strong attention to control definitions and evidence.
    • Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and ability to communicate clear, actionable insights to stakeholders; demonstrated critical thinking, leveraging technology
    and data to perform call quality monitoring efficiently and meet KPIs.
    • Ability to enforce scope, standard work, and governance discipline in ambiguous settings.
    • Highly proficient in MS Office tools, quality monitoring and contact center results analysis, and reporting; experience leveraging technology and data to support
    monitoring outcomes.
    • Experience working with systems such as Salesforce, Verint, Genesys, Five9 and other quality monitoring systems (AI solution experience a plus); bilingual
    Spanish/English proficiency with strong reading, writing, and spoken skills.
    Preferred Experience:
    • Experience supporting omni-channel or technology-enabled operations (e.g., phone, email, chat), launch/hypercare periods including rapid risk sensing and
    prioritization, and within healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.
    • Experience building calibration routines, QA playbooks, and monitoring standard work; Six Sigma certification.

The salary for this position is expected to range between $114,100 and 211,900.00 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. jobs.description:
EVERSANA is expanding its Salesforce delivery capacity as part of the AI Hub initiative — and doing so with a new expectation: developers work AI-first. The Sr. Salesforce Developer — AI-Augmented builds and ships Salesforce Health Cloud (ACTICS) features while using AI development tooling as their primary way of working and consuming the agents produced by the AI Hub Center of Excellence.

This is a senior hands-on Salesforce role for someone who is fluent in Apex, LWC, and SOQL and is energized — not threatened — by AI-accelerated development. The role delivers roadmap features faster by pairing strong Salesforce engineering with AI-assisted coding, test generation, and COE-built workflow agents. Both FTE and contractor variants of this role exist; responsibilities are identical.

Mission: Deliver Salesforce Health Cloud features on the ACTICS roadmap, accelerated by AI-first tooling and COE-built agents — at a higher velocity and quality bar than traditional development.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Salesforce Delivery

  • Design, build, and ship Salesforce Health Cloud features using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Flow, per the ACTICS roadmap.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce integrations via REST APIs and Platform Events, coordinating with the MuleSoft integration team.
  • Deliver against sprint commitments in a parallel-track delivery model with compressed timelines.

AI-Augmented Practice

  • Use AI development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot — as primary daily tooling, not as an optional aid.
  • Consume COE-built agents (intake automation, missing-information workflow, QNCR reporting, workload queue intelligence) within Salesforce workflows.
  • Practice test-first AI prompting: generate and validate unit tests and Apex test coverage with AI assistance.
  • Validate all AI-generated code against ACTICS quality standards before commit; treat AI output as a draft to be reviewed, never as final.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Pair with the AI Solutions Engineer on Salesforce-side agent integration and on exposing Salesforce data and actions to agents safely.
  • Contribute reusable prompts and patterns to the shared prompt/pattern library, and provide feedback that improves COE agents.
  • Participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving — with attention to the correctness of AI-generated work.
  • Uphold PHI/HIPAA handling standards in all Salesforce and AI-assisted work.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, including Apex, LWC, and SOQL.
  • Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud or a comparable Salesforce industry cloud.
  • Experience building Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, Platform Events, external services).
  • Demonstrated use of — or strong readiness to adopt — AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Einstein for Developers).
  • Sound understanding of prompt engineering for code generation and of how to review AI-generated code critically.
  • Comfortable delivering in a fast-paced, compressed-timeline, parallel-track environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification.
  • Healthcare, life-sciences, or Patient Services domain experience.
  • Exposure to AI agents, RAG, or LLM-based workflows in a development context.
  • MuleSoft or DataWeave familiarity.

Tools & Stack

  • AI development: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Einstein for Developers.
  • Salesforce: Salesforce Platform, Health Cloud, ACTICS.
  • Integration: MuleSoft / DataWeave.
  • Lifecycle: Git, Azure DevOps, JIRA.

First-Year Success Measures

  • Consistent delivery of ACTICS roadmap features at the team's AI-accelerated velocity targets.
  • AI development tooling used routinely, with measurable contribution to code-generation and test-automation metrics.
  • COE-built agents successfully integrated into Salesforce workflows for at least the priority use cases.
