jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, AI, you will be tasked with extending SentinelOne's engineering capacity directly into the departments that need it most, including Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Security, People, Legal, and beyond. Unlike a platform or product engineer working behind a backlog, you will embed with the stakeholders who own a problem, scope it end to end, and ship a working custom application into their hands, often in days or weeks, not quarters. This role blends hands-on full-stack engineering, rapid prototyping with modern AI tools, and the judgment to know when to build, when to reuse, and when to say no.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Embed with a functional department for a defined engagement, running discovery to understand workflows and pain points before writing a line of code.
  • Scope, design, and build full-stack custom applications (not just automations or scripts) using modern frameworks, AI coding assistants, and internal platform APIs, moving from prototype to production quickly.
  • Own delivery end to end including architecture, build, testing, deployment, and the training and handoff that gets a department to actually adopt what you built.
  • Work hands-on in the code alongside AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to compress build cycles, iterating with stakeholders in near real time rather than through long requirements documents.
  • Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality as requirements shift, and communicate those trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Data teams so every deployed application meets SentinelOne's standards for data security, compliance, and long-term supportability.
  • Codify recurring patterns, components, and playbooks from each engagement into reusable building blocks for the next department and for the broader engineering organization.
  • Feed field learnings back to platform, product, and data teams covering what worked, what broke, and what the next generation of internal tools should look like.
  • Measure and report success through production adoption and measurable business impact, not lines of code shipped or tickets closed.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience with a demonstrated ability to design, build, and ship full-stack applications (frontend and backend) independently.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (Python, Node.js/JavaScript, or comparable) and enough frontend ability to build usable internal tools without waiting on a dedicated design or frontend team.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development, plus a working understanding of APIs, webhooks, data structures, and integration patterns.
  • A track record of working directly with non-technical stakeholders including scoping ambiguous requests, managing expectations, and shipping something real rather than a deck.
  • Comfort operating with significant autonomy and shifting priorities across departments and problem spaces where the right solution is rarely handed to you.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to a functional VP as easily as to a fellow engineer.
  • Prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, professional services, or startup generalist role where you owned a project from discovery through production is preferred.
  • Exposure to enterprise security, compliance, or data governance requirements given the internal, security-conscious environment you will be building in is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Operations team is looking for an experienced fraud analyst to join an industry-leading global fraud operations team. This position is responsible for writing and maintaining fraud rulesets to prevent transaction fraud, conducting data analysis to identify and mitigate fraud attacks, while minimizing impact to users, and working collaboratively with fraud, operations, and product stakeholders to proactively implement fraud strategies and controls. They should have a deep understanding of fraud patterns and typologies, advanced SQL proficiency, strong analytical abilities, and experience writing and managing fraud rulesets.

What you'll do

Did you know that only around 4% of the world's GDP comes from internet commerce? At Stripe, we believe that this represents a future with almost limitless potential for innovation, creativity, and global prosperity. While the promise of a global online economy is palpable, it doesn't come without significant risk. Each day, bad actors disrupt the trust and safety of the internet and increase the barrier of entry for online businesses. Before we can fully realize the potential of a global internet economy, we must first address the burgeoning problem of fraud.

We are looking for someone passionate about fighting fraud, identifying new trends and typologies, conducting complex data analysis, and working collaboratively with peers and partners in the fraud space. This position works closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, data science, and operations to identify and mitigate risk from complex, distributed transaction fraud attacks.

The right candidate for this role will have a minimum of five years' experience conducting advanced data analysis using SQL, preferably within the fraud space across e-commerce, payments, or cryptocurrency. Candidates should have experience writing, maintaining, and analyzing complex fraud rulesets and demonstrated success minimizing fraud losses along with impacts to users. Candidates should also have experience working closely with product teams to implement risk controls and demonstrate a deep understanding of fraud typologies, controls, and ability to mitigate fraud risk.

Responsibilities

Role Title: Strategy & Business Analysis Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (NAMER and Europe-based)

micro1 is engaging Strategy & Business Analysis Specialists to contribute to a project designed to assess and elevate the performance of advanced AI models in producing executive-level business deliverables. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and author strategy and analysis tasks that simulate real-world business challenges, including providing multi-file inputs (spreadsheets, PDFs, and source data).
  2. Create gold-standard deliverables such as PowerPoint board decks, investment committee memos, and robust Excel financial models that reflect senior stakeholder expectations.
  3. Establish the appropriate analytical frameworks, employing MECE structure and defensible recommendations for each scenario.
  4. Develop detailed evaluation rubrics (35+ items) to assess AI model outputs on structure, accuracy, and executive-readiness.
  5. Identify and document common failure modes in strategy communication, including unclear recommendations, logical inconsistencies, and unsupported figures.
  6. Ensure all produced content exhibits clean visual storytelling, numerical rigor, and polished executive presentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Approximately 5 years of experience in management consulting (MBB, tier-2), investment banking, PE, corporate strategy, or FP&A settings.
  2. Hands-on ownership of board-level decks, strategy recommendations, or investment committee memos subject to senior review.
  3. Expertise in financial modeling from scratch within Excel, encompassing scenario and sensitivity analysis.
  4. Mastery of structured problem-solving approaches (MECE, issue trees, pyramid principle) and executive communication best practices.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with a proven ability to produce executive-facing content.
  6. Experience developing outputs against in-house or standardized deck templates.
  7. Sector-specific analytical exposure (such as TMT, healthcare, consumer, or financial services) is advantageous.
  8. Prior experience with rubric writing or AI training projects is a plus, though not required.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.excerpt: SEO & Content Specialist / StrategistGrowth & Lifecycle Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Do the work that makes Seeking the answer wherever daters search, scroll, and ask — hand-coded, hand-written, and shipped by you.
jobs.description:
SEO & Content Specialist / Strategist

Growth & Lifecycle Marketing | Full-Time, Exempt | Reports to Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

Do the work that makes Seeking the answer wherever daters search, scroll, and ask — hand-coded, hand-written, and shipped by you.

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote (US).

Compensation $75,000 to $115,000 base, commensurate with experience and level. Performance and outcome-dependent incentive plan included.

Travel Required for team meetings, offsites, and project needs.

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world’s largest premium dating platform, and we are entering the most important chapter of our brand transformation. We are looking for an SEO & Content Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of Seeking’s organic content engine end to end as a hands-on operator: hand-editing HTML for on-page SEO, writing and shipping content, coordinating outside partners, and applying the tactics that earn brand visibility across traditional search, AI Overviews, and answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.

This role is open at two levels: SEO & Content Specialist and SEO & Content Strategist. Level and placement in the salary band are determined by experience, depth in on-page SEO and content execution, and demonstrated ownership of end-to-end organic wins. The role is the same shape at both levels; the Strategist level carries broader scope, more autonomy, and higher expectations on discovery strategy, cross-channel synthesis, and mentorship.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is SEO Specialist, SEO Analyst, Content Marketing Specialist, Content Strategist, Organic Growth Specialist, SEO Copywriter, Editorial SEO Manager, Content SEO Manager, or Digital Marketing Specialist. If your day-to-day is writing content, editing HTML on the page, and moving pages up the SERP and into AI answers, you should apply regardless of your current title.

You will edit the HTML, write the content, brief the vendors, read the numbers, and rewrite the plan by Friday. You will report to the Director of Growth & Lifecycle Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Brand, Product, Data & Analytics, and outside agency and freelance partners.

Let’s be direct: we are not looking for a strategist who briefs the work to an agency and waits for the deck. We tried that and got senior operators who could not sit down and ship an on-page fix themselves. This role is for a builder who can log into the CMS in week one, audit how Seeking shows up across every surface that matters, hand-edit a page for on-page SEO, publish a piece of content, and coordinate an agency deliverable — all by the end of week two. If that is you, keep reading.

What You’ll Own

On-Page & Technical SEO Execution

  • Edit HTML and CMS templates directly to implement on-page SEO best practices: title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy (H1–H3), schema and structured data, internal linking, image alt text, and clean URL structure.
  • Run routine technical SEO health checks (crawlability, indexation, page speed basics, broken links, redirects) and either fix them yourself or coordinate the fix.
  • Maintain WordPress-based properties (Seeking blog, STNDRDS, and adjacent brands), keeping HTML clean, semantic, and shippable.
  • Implement structured data, schema markup, and entity tagging so search engines and AI answer engines can read and cite the page correctly.

Content Writing & Editorial Execution

  • Write, edit, and publish organic content — blog posts, landing pages, FAQs, category pages, and pillar hubs — aligned to defined content pillars and audience segments.
  • Ship content directly when speed, voice, or judgment require it. You are a writer as much as a strategist.
  • Contribute to and help maintain the editorial calendar across owned channels, and align it with brand campaigns, product launches, and cultural moments.
  • Identify content gaps, refresh opportunities, and topical authority angles, and turn them into published assets.
  • Develop entity-driven content strategies that give AI systems clear, authoritative, structured answers so Seeking is the source they cite.

Discoverability Across Search, AI Overviews, and Answer Engines

  • Run keyword research, intent expansion, and competitive discovery analysis using GA4, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to inform content and on-page decisions.
  • Structure content and markup to earn visibility on AI-powered discovery surfaces, including AI Overviews, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Increase brand presence across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and the next wave of LLM-powered discovery surfaces, using clear, extractable, citation-ready formatting.
  • Stay current on emerging discoverability tactics and bring practical, tested recommendations back to the team.

External Partner & Vendor Coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for external agency and freelance partners supporting content, SEO, and production work.
  • Manage deliverable timelines, feedback loops, and quality checks for agency-produced content and SEO work. Hold the line on scope, brief, and quality.
  • Bring in outside skill where it makes the work better, but stay hands-on enough that no partner can outrun your understanding of the actual work.

Reporting & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Track and report on the small set of KPIs that matter (organic traffic, rankings, indexation, engagement, and AI-search visibility) on a weekly and monthly cadence.
  • Translate performance data into next-cycle priorities. Flag risks early and route them to the right internal team.
  • Partner with Creative, Brand, Product, Legal, and other marketing functions to ship content and on-page changes on schedule and on-brand.
  • Support ad hoc organic growth initiatives (for example, reputation and review monitoring) as directed.

Required Qualifications (Both Levels)

  • Hands-on SEO and content experience at a consumer brand — ideally a consumer subscription, marketplace, mobile-first, or dating/social platform — with published work and measurable results you can point to.
  • Working fluency in HTML and CSS, sufficient to make on-page SEO edits directly in a CMS. You can open the source, fix the header hierarchy, correct the schema, and publish without waiting on a developer.
  • Strong grasp of traditional SEO fundamentals: on-page optimization, keyword research, internal linking, and technical basics (crawlability, indexation, page speed, structured data).
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone and format across blog, landing page, FAQ, and category content.
  • Working fluency in AEO and GEO. You understand schema markup, structured data, brand-entity strategy, and how AI answer engines choose which sources to cite. You have a point of view on which signals matter and which are noise.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Search Console, and at least one paid SEO platform (SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable). You read your own analytics.
  • Working knowledge of WordPress sufficient to maintain and update production pages, and light front-end fluency to read and adjust HTML, CSS, and component-level changes when needed.
  • AI fluency. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, Cowork, or similar in your daily workflow to research, draft, structure, and QA content, and to replace work you used to do by hand. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you.
  • Ready to run on day one. You can audit how Seeking shows up across search and AI surfaces, identify what is broken, and ship a fix in week one.
  • Operator’s discipline. You ship on time, your QA is tight, your naming and metadata are clean, and you document what you did.

Level & Experience

SEO & Content Specialist

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in SEO, content, or organic growth at a consumer brand or agency serving consumer brands.
  • Practical track record of hand-editing pages, publishing content, and moving pages up the SERP with results you can walk through.
  • Owns execution end-to-end across on-page SEO, content writing, and agency coordination. Contributes to editorial calendar and discovery priorities with the Director.

SEO & Content Strategist

  • 4 to 7+ years of hands-on experience in SEO and content, ideally including time at a consumer subscription business, DTC brand, or category-defining consumer brand.
  • Proven track record leading organic growth programs that combine on-page execution, editorial planning, and AI-search visibility, with measurable business impact.
  • Owns both execution and strategy. Sets the discovery roadmap, drives the editorial calendar, and can defend a prioritization call to the Director and CMO.
  • Comfortable owning or contributing to an editorial calendar across multiple content channels, and directing agency and freelance partners at scope.
  • Mentors and reviews. Comfortable being the go-to reviewer for on-page work, content quality, and discovery strategy as the function scales.
  • Direct experience optimizing for zero-click results, featured snippets, AI Overviews, and answer-engine citations at a consumer brand.

Preferred Qualifications (Both Levels)

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly skilled and intellectually curious analyst to shape the future of financial data at Instacart, driving innovation at the intersection of systems, analytics, and business strategy.

In this role, you will architect and deliver data models, pipelines, and reporting infrastructure that empower Finance and Accounting with trusted insights at scale.

You’ll collaborate across technical and business teams to ensure financial data is accurate, reliable, and compliant, while also advancing large-scale systems initiatives, accelerating the month-end close, and optimizing cloud spend in our AWS environment.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Data Analytics team is the connective tissue between Finance, Accounting, and Engineering. Our mission is to deliver trusted financial data that is both a foundation for compliance and a catalyst for strategic decision-making. We combine technical depth with financial expertise to build scalable, high-value data solutions—transforming complexity into clarity and empowering leaders to act with confidence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Bridge Data & Business Needs – Translate business requirements into scalable data models by asking the right questions, digging into details, and mining insights that create measurable impact.
  • Own Data Initiatives End-to-End – Take ambiguous ideas and transform them into well-defined, high-impact projects with clear deliverables.
  • Build Decision-Making Tools – Design and automate dashboards, models, and reporting systems that surface clear insights and guide long-term growth strategies.
  • Support Revenue Accounting – Build and maintain data products (dashboards, reports, analyses) that underpin the Revenue Accounting organization, including embedding revenue recognition logic into robust financial data models.
  • Ensure Compliance & Governance – Apply compliance-first design principles to support SOX, audit readiness, and enforce data governance standards.
  • Maintain Data Integrity – Implement validation, monitoring, and reconciliation frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability across financial datasets.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement – Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and system enhancement, unlocking efficiency across Finance and Accounting.
  • Leverage AI & Next-Generation Analytics – Harness cutting-edge AI technologies (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Python ML libraries, Copilot) to reimagine how financial data is modeled, automated, and delivered—accelerating insights, scaling workflows, and shaping the future of financial analytics.

ABOUT YOU

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years (7+ preferred) of experience in data analytics or analytics engineering roles
  • Strong SQL and cloud data fundamentals, with hands-on experience in Snowflake, dbt, and BI tools (Mode, Looker, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience building and supporting complex data pipelines with emphasis on accuracy, compliance, and traceability
  • Familiarity with financial data structures, accounting processes, and enterprise systems (e.g., Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Adaptive)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage effectively across technical and non-technical teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Public company experience with exposure to SOX compliance
  • Background in high-growth technology environments
  • Experience implementing large-scale financial or operational systems (ERP, enterprise data platforms, etc.)
  • Project management experience a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to support Finance and Accounting teams with scalable data solutions
  • Cloud cost management experience, ideally in an AWS environment
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications in data analytics (e.g., natural language SQL tools, forecasting models, anomaly detection frameworks)

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

jobs.title: Datastore Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care.
jobs.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

What you will be doing

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon’s platform, defining our foundational data model and serving as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies and home sleep tests. As we expand our partnerships and real-world data integrations, we are looking for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of data platforms, customer needs, and applied problem solving.

In this role, you will work directly with Beacon’s external partners to understand their technical use cases, guide integrations with our APIs and datasets, and develop integrated solutions that enable them to unlock value from Beacon’s data platform. Internally, you will collaborate closely with Datastore engineers, product managers, and scientific teams to translate partner needs into robust data models, application features, and integration tooling, and to improve our ability to troubleshoot and resolve client issues at scale.

This role emphasizes deploying and extending Beacon's data platform in real-world partner environments. You will write production application and integration code against our PostgreSQL-backed GraphQL API, shipping features, tooling, and proof-of-concept integrations, primarily on Beacon's platform and potentially on a partner's, to help them succeed with Beacon's data.

This is an engineering role, held to the same technical bar as the rest of the Datastore team. You should expect to write SQL by hand, and to be assessed on the same coding and feature-design exercises.

What success looks like

  • You work directly with external partners and customers to understand their data needs, analytical workflows, and technical constraints, and translate these into concrete solutions and application features built on Beacon’s Datastore
  • You lead technical conversations with partner engineers and data teams, supporting API integrations, successful adoption of data access patterns and practices, and downstream analytics
  • You design, build, and ship solutions for customers, sometimes on the Beacon platform and sometimes on the customer’s platform, to kickstart and expedite integration and provide examples that showcase and validate Beacon’s data
  • You collaborate with the rest of the Datastore team to develop internal tools, services, and queries that improve observability, troubleshooting, and resolution of client data issues
  • You leverage feedback from partners and internal stakeholders to improve documentation, APIs, data models, and operational processes
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and balance pragmatism with rigor, delivering solutions quickly while maintaining high standards for data integrity, correctness, and maintainability
  • You debug production data issues end to end - from a customer's report, through logs, pipelines, and the database - to a root cause and a fix

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, data engineering, or data platform engineering, including hands-on application development
  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role, delivering solutions directly to external partners or clients.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL with production PostgreSQL experience; you write and tune queries by hand, and you're comfortable reasoning about schema design, indexes, and query plans
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining operational data models
  • Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders to solve data-related problems, including requirements gathering, solution design, and delivery
  • You work across the stack, querying and modeling data, and writing the application and integration code that ships to partners. Application development is a core part of this role, not an occasional one
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Julia. Our Datastore stack is SQL, TypeScript, and Julia - experience with Julia is a strong plus but not required, and we welcome candidates eager to learn it
  • Experience building and consuming APIs — our partner-facing surface is GraphQL — plus familiarity with integration patterns (REST, batch exports, ELT/ETL, event sourcing, and the like)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A collaborative, customer-oriented mindset — you enjoy partnering across teams and organizations to solve real problems

Nice to have

  • Experience working in healthcare, life sciences, or regulated data environments
  • Comfortable querying a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake) and building the occasional dashboard (we use Superset)

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you’re excited to build software at the intersection of data platforms, healthcare, and real-world partnerships, and care deeply about data quality and usability, we’d love to hear from you!

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - 170,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location.The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.
At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Finance and Strategy Data Science builds the forecasting models, data infrastructure, and analytics tools at the core of how Stripe measures and plans its business. The team owns everything from hierarchical time series and agentic forecasting tools that predict payment volumes and revenue margins, to the governed metrics platform that feeds company-wide dashboards and executive reporting. We partner closely with Finance and Strategy, GTM, and Product stakeholders to directly inform financial decisions across Stripe's entire business. The team combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and executive partnership that develops both technical and business expertise.

What you’ll do

Data Science Managers at Stripe are responsible for the success of their team. You'll be deeply involved in the modeling and design processes as well as coaching, mentoring, and leading the team. You'll have a deep understanding of how to drive efficient data science teams and you'll have a strong user-focus. You'll be working with data scientists, analysts, and engineers on creating technical solutions and communicating effectively across teams and senior leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the roadmap and priorities for your team, and work with many Stripe leaders across the company to enhance our ability to be data-driven.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as engineering, analytics, operations, finance, and marketing.
  • Lead and manage processes to help the team do its best work and engage effectively with the rest of Stripe.
  • Manage a high-performing team of data scientists, supporting them to achieve a high level of technical excellence and advance in their careers.
  • Recruit and onboard great data scientists, in collaboration with Stripe's recruiting team.
  • Contribute to broad data science initiatives as a member of Stripe's data science management team.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • You have at least 3 years of direct management experience leading data science or ML teams, and 10 years of overall data science experience.
  • You've demonstrated expertise in designing metrics and guiding business decisions with data.
  • You have technical expertise to drive clarity with staff and senior scientists about architecture and strategic modeling decisions.
  • You've managed teams that have built and shipped machine learning systems and data products at scale, and have hands-on experience with challenging problems.
  • You work very well cross-functionally, and are able to think rigorously and make hard decisions and tradeoffs.
  • You have clear and persuasive communication skills in writing and in speech.
  • You thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
  • You foster a healthy, inclusive, challenging, and supportive work environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • A PhD or MS in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering)
  • You're comfortable working with geographically distributed teams.
  • Expertise in time series forecasting, predictive modeling, or optimization
  • Expertise in data design and building scalable data architectures

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

jobs.description:
About AAPCHO

The Association of Asian Pacific Community Health Organizations (AAPCHO) was formed in 1987 by community health centers primarily serving medically underserved Asian/Asian American (A/AA) & Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander (NH/PI) communities. The goal of these organizations was to create a national voice to advocate for the unique and diverse health needs of A/AA and NH/PI communities and the community health providers that serve those needs.

AAPCHO’s mission is dedicated to promoting advocacy, collaboration, and leadership that improves the health status and access of A/AA and NH/PI communities within the continental U.S., Hawai’i, U.S. Territories, and Freely Associated States. Our vision is to be a national leader and critical voice for A/AA and NH/PI community health centers and consumers, ensuring that our communities have better access to affordable, high-quality, and culturally and linguistically proficient health care.

OUR VALUES

The following shared values underlie every aspect of AAPCHO and its member health centers’ functions and operations:

  • Health care is a right not a privilege - All people must have access to affordable quality care, regardless of language, culture, immigration status and ability to pay. No one is turned away due to inability to pay and our services and policies are designed to eliminate barriers and provide access to all.
  • Wellness - Health is much more than the absence of disease. It includes physical, mental and spiritual well-being for individuals, families and communities. We acknowledge and respect different definitions of wellness and health within our communities.
  • Community Accountability and Empowerment - Communities are the experts on their own health and essential participants in the health of their communities, families and selves. Our services and programs are informed by and responsive to community voices.
  • Diversity as Strength - AA and NHPI communities are rich in diversity of language, cultural heritage, spirituality, history, experience, health beliefs and practices. Many have undergone the hardships of war, colonization, poverty, or immigration to a foreign land. We honor and value the strengths of every culture and individual.
  • Collaboration Among Communities of Color – Communities of color share a history of disparities and exclusion as well as a common interest in health and health care equity. jobs.excerpt: RESPONSABILITÉS S'approprier et faire évoluer la vision architecturale : • Prendre en charge la philosophie d'architecture actuelle pour la faire évoluer de manière itérative et pragmatique.
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS

S'approprier et faire évoluer la vision architecturale :

  • Prendre en charge la philosophie d'architecture actuelle pour la faire évoluer de manière itérative et pragmatique. Vous capitaliserez sur nos fondations existantes pour mener une modernisation progressive, sans chercher à tout réinventer.

Gérer la complexité à long terme :

  • Structurer, gouverner et assurer la pérennité de notre écosystème technologique, en gérant habilement la cohabitation entre nos systèmes historiques et les nouvelles solutions.

Arbitrer les décisions technologiques structurantes :

  • Trancher les choix critiques liés à l'architecture, l'intégration, la sécurité, les données, l'IA, le cloud, la scalabilité et les stratégies d'acquisition (make vs buy).

Piloter la gouvernance architecturale :

  • Animer et optimiser les mécanismes de gouvernance (revues d’architecture, registres de décisions/ADR, gestion des exceptions) pour assurer des choix technologiques éclairés, documentés et alignés avec notre évolution.

Promouvoir les standards corporatifs :

  • Définir, adapter et accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des normes et patterns d'architecture, en s'assurant qu'ils s'intègrent naturellement et apportent une réelle valeur à notre contexte.

Incarner le leadership technique :

  • Agir à titre d'expert de référence, de mentor et de leader d'influence pour l'ensemble des équipes techniques, en les guidant de manière proactive dans leurs défis complexes.

Assurer l'alignement stratégique :

  • Vulgariser les concepts architecturaux pour créer une synergie forte entre la R&D, les équipes plateformes, le DevOps et la direction. Vous ferez le pont entre la vision technologique et les objectifs d'affaires.

Fédérer la communauté d’architecture :

  • Développer et animer une communauté de pratique interne pour faire rayonner l'excellence technique, partager les connaissances et soutenir l'évolution de nos méthodes de travail.

Instaurer les garde-fous non fonctionnels (NFR) :

  • Définir et intégrer les standards d'excellence essentiels à nos solutions, avec un accent intransigeant sur la sécurité, la fiabilité, la performance et l'optimisation des coûts infonuagiques (FinOps).

Garantir l'exploitabilité en production :

  • Concevoir des architectures distribuées résilientes en s'assurant qu'elles intègrent l'observabilité dès la conception (by design). Votre objectif est de garantir que nos systèmes demeurent hautement mesurables, maintenables et faciles à opérer à grande échelle.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Expérience et parcours

  • 10 années d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle et en technologies de l'information.
  • 5 années d'expérience confirmée dans un rôle d'architecture (architecture de solutions, de plateforme ou d'entreprise), idéalement dans un contexte multiproduits.
  • Compréhension approfondie des architectures cloud, micro services et des environnements SaaS.
  • Expérience concrète dans la modernisation de systèmes (ex: transition d'architectures monolithiques vers des architectures distribuées), avec une approche itérative.

Expertise technique

  • Écosystème de développement : Maîtrise des environnements .NET et des technologies front-end modernes (particulièrement Angular).
  • Infrastructures et conteneurisation : Solide expertise avec Docker et Kubernetes, incluant le déploiement et la gestion dans des environnements cloud hybrides ou « on-premise » (sur site).
  • Pratiques d'ingénierie : Maîtrise des concepts CI/CD et de l'automatisation, avec une forte expérience sur Azure DevOps.
  • Gouvernance technique : Habileté démontrée à définir des standards de sécurité, d'observabilité et de performance (NFR).

Savoir-être et Leadership

  • Pragmatisme et sens des affaires : Capacité à équilibrer l'excellence technique avec la réalité des systèmes existants (legacy) et les objectifs de rentabilité (ROI).
  • Excellente communication : Talent pour vulgariser des concepts complexes et adapter son discours selon l'auditoire (développeurs, DevOps, direction, équipes d'affaires).
  • Leadership d'influence : Capacité à fédérer, convaincre et mentorer les équipes sans nécessairement avoir d'autorité hiérarchique directe.
  • Bilinguisme : Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.

Ce que nous offrons:

  • Opportunités d’avancement professionnel
  • Couverture médicale, dentaire et vision complète
  • 3 semaines de vacances et cinq jours personnels
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés et programmes de jumelage REER/401(k)
  • Récompenses liées au mode de vie
  • Implication communautaire et responsabilité sociale
  • Environnement de travail collaboratif

*Seuls les candidats retenus seront contactés*.

Si vous êtes une personne en situation de handicap, vous pouvez recevoir de l'aide pour le processus de sélection et de sélection sur demande.

jobs.description:
TENNESSEE REMOTE PSYCHIATRIC-MENTAL HEALTH NURSE PRACTITIONER (PMHNP)

Initiating Visit & Supervising Practitioner : Principal Illness Navigation, Peer Support (PIN-PS)

Independent Contractor (1099) | Telehealth/ Remote position | You Are Accountable

ABOUT THE ROLE

You Are Accountable operates behavioral health programs built around Principal Illness Navigation – Peer Support (PIN-PS), a Medicare care-navigation benefit in which certified peer support specialists walk alongside patients living with serious behavioral health conditions. Every patient's navigation episode must begin with a qualifying initiating visit furnished by a billing practitioner, and the ongoing peer navigation is billed incident to that practitioner's services under general supervision. That practitioner is you.

This is a flexible, telehealth-based contractor role with meaningful clinical leverage: you conduct the psychiatric evaluation that opens each patient's episode, set the plan of care the peer team supports, and remain available as the supervising clinician while peer specialists deliver month-to-month navigation. You control your own schedule, and compensation scales directly with the work you personally perform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct initiating visits (e.g., psychiatric diagnostic evaluations, CPT 90791, or E/M visits) via telehealth for patients entering PIN-PS programs, establishing the diagnosis, medical necessity, and plan of care the navigation services will support.
  • Document each visit in our EHR within 48 hours to clean, billable standards, including patient consent to navigation services where required.
  • Serve as the billing practitioner of record for enrolled patients and provide general supervision of the certified peer support specialists furnishing navigation incident to your services.
  • Furnish follow-up visits for your enrolled patients where clinically indicated and mutually agreed.
  • Cooperate with quality, audit, and payer-compliance activities relating to your patients.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Active, unrestricted APRN/NP licensure in one or more of: Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Tennessee, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or New York (multi-state licensure a plus). State credential titles vary (APRN, CRNP, APN, NP) — all are welcome.
  • National board certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC).
  • Any physician collaboration, supervision, or protocol arrangement required by your state (e.g., prescriptive authority agreement in TX; collaborative agreement in PA; joint protocol in NJ; practice agreement or NP Modernization Act qualification in NY; supervisory protocol in FL) — we can discuss support here. We also have physicians that we work with that can provide this.
  • Active NPI; eligibility to enroll with and reassign benefits to our professional entities for Medicare and Medicaid; never excluded from any federal or state health care program.
  • Comfort with telehealth care for adults with serious behavioral health conditions, and an appreciation for peer support as part of the care team.

COMPENSATION

  • Professional services: 80% of net collections for each service you personally furnish, paid within 30 days after the month we receive payment from the funding source, with full per-service reporting.
  • Supervision stipend: $5.00 per supervised patient per month for each month billable navigation services are furnished to that patient under your supervision.
  • Malpractice coverage: professional liability coverage for your services under this engagement provided at our expense ($1M per claim / $3M aggregate).

ENGAGEMENT DETAILS

1099 independent contractor; you keep full independent clinical judgment and set your own schedule around agreed availability. The role is non-exclusive — most of our practitioners maintain other practices. Because each patient's navigation episode depends on continuity with their billing practitioner, the agreement includes a 12-month notice period for termination without cause, which ends early automatically once your enrolled patients have been transitioned to a successor practitioner with continuity of care maintained; after giving notice you are never obligated to take on new patients.

You Are Accountable is an equal opportunity organization. All engagements are subject to credentialing, exclusion screening, and payer enrollment.

ABOUT BETTER IMPACT

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities.

Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact. We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

THE ROLE

When a product changes, good communication can be the difference between “wait, what happened?” and “got it, I know exactly what this means for me.”

As our CX Enablement Communication Advisor, you’ll own how important product and customer experience changes are communicated to our customers and CX teams. You’ll take complex information and turn it into communication that is clear, useful, appropriately timed, and easy to act on.

This isn’t simply a writing role. You’ll think strategically about audience, timing, channel, message, and outcome, helping people understand what’s changing, why it matters, and what they should do next.

This role can be performed remotely.

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO

  • Own communication planning for product releases and customer experience changes, from early planning through launch and reinforcement.
  • Translate complex product information into clear customer and employee communications, including release notes, announcements, campaigns, and enablement materials.
  • Build and manage our customer communication calendar, balancing timing, audience, priority, and frequency across initiatives.
  • Create communication campaigns that build awareness and encourage adoption of new and existing product capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, Support, and Enablement to identify communication needs and keep messaging aligned.
  • Help steward customer-facing product language, including terminology, feature messaging, and in-product language recommendations.
  • Use engagement, adoption, customer feedback, and support trends to understand what’s working and continuously improve our communication.

Requirements

You might be a great fit if you have 3+ years of experience in customer communications, product communications, product marketing, enablement, content strategy, customer experience, or a related area. We care more about what you’ve actually owned and accomplished than whether your previous title matches ours exactly.

You’re an excellent writer and editor, but you also think beyond the individual message. You can take complicated information, ask the right questions, and make it understandable and actionable for someone who wasn’t in the room.

You’re someone who can:

  • Own communication strategy and execution for product releases, customer-facing changes, or similar initiatives.
  • Develop clear, engaging communications for different audiences and channels.
  • Translate technical or complex information into customer-friendly language without losing what matters.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Customer Operations Strategy, AI & Automation
jobs.excerpt: Engageware is looking for a hands-on, strategic, and data-driven Senior Director of Operations Strategy, AI & Automation to lead the operating model, systems strategy, and automation roadmap across Customer Success, Support, Services, and Marketing Operations.
jobs.description:
Engageware is looking for a hands-on, strategic, and data-driven Senior Director of Operations Strategy, AI & Automation to lead the operating model, systems strategy, and automation roadmap across Customer Success, Support, Services, and Marketing Operations.

You will be responsible for turning great customer and go-to-market work into scalable systems by standardizing how teams operate, improving visibility into performance and risk, and identifying where AI and automation can reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and create better customer and business outcomes.

Reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer, you will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations, IT, and Marketing leadership to build the processes, tooling, data flows, and operating discipline required to scale a modern, AI-enabled customer organization with strong lifecycle and operating alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Customer Operating Model

  • Serve as the senior leader for Customer Operations strategy across Customer Success, Support, Services, and Marketing Operations, setting the vision for how the organization scales with consistency, discipline, and leverage.
  • Define and lead the operating model for the customer organization and its key lifecycle touchpoints with Marketing, including core workflows, ownership boundaries, cross-functional handoffs, governance, and management cadences.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that reduce friction across the customer lifecycle, from demand generation and handoff through onboarding, adoption, support, escalation, renewal, and services delivery.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Services, and Marketing leaders to translate business goals into measurable operating plans, systems requirements, and execution priorities.
  • Build an organization that operates with one-team consistency across products, regions, and customer segments rather than relying on local workarounds or individual heroics.

AI & Automation Strategy

  • Define and drive the roadmap for applying AI and automation across the customer organization, balancing practical workflow automation with higher-leverage AI use cases.
  • Identify where manual work can be eliminated, standardized, accelerated, or improved through automation in areas such as health scoring, QBR preparation, customer insights, case triage, escalation workflows, knowledge access, and service delivery operations.
  • Create a framework to evaluate automation opportunities based on impact, feasibility, risk, and change-management cost.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and IT to implement internal tooling, workflow orchestration, and agent-assisted processes that improve customer outcomes and team efficiency.
  • Establish clear guardrails for where automation is appropriate, where AI should assist but not decide, and where human judgment must remain primary.

Customer Success, Support, Services & Marketing Operations

  • Own the systems and processes that support account health management, proactive customer motions, renewal readiness, support escalation management, services coordination, and lifecycle marketing handoffs.
  • Improve operating discipline across the organization by standardizing playbooks, stage definitions, service motions, escalation paths, campaign and follow-up workflows, and handoff expectations.
  • Design workflows that help the organization move from reactive service to proactive, insight-led customer engagement.
  • Partner with Support leadership to improve SLA visibility, case flow, triage quality, and escalation readiness.
  • Partner with Services leadership to improve project visibility, delivery consistency, capacity planning inputs, and customer handoffs before, during, and after implementation work.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations on lifecycle processes, data quality, segmentation inputs, campaign handoff logic, and reporting alignment across the funnel and customer base.

Systems, Data & Workflow Architecture

  • Own the strategy for the operations tech stack, including systems such as Gainsight, Salesforce, Glean, Jira, ThoughtSpot, Clay, and related workflow and reporting tools.
  • Ensure customer signals, marketing lifecycle events, operational events, and account data flow cleanly across systems so teams can act from a shared source of truth.
  • Improve data quality, taxonomy, and workflow hygiene across the tools that power Customer Success, Support, Services, and Marketing Operations.
  • Lead the design of scalable workflows for customer-impact prioritization, ticket linkage, escalation documentation, account intelligence, campaign-to-customer handoffs, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Partner with technical teams on system administration priorities, integrations, permissions, data models, and automation design.

Reporting, Insights & Performance Management

  • Build and oversee the reporting framework for the customer organization and its marketing lifecycle dependencies, including metrics, dashboards, and recurring operating reviews for leadership.
  • Establish clear visibility into customer health, support performance, services delivery, escalations, renewals, automation impact, and key lifecycle conversion points.
  • Develop measurement approaches that quantify the business value of automation and AI, including time saved, touch reduction, faster response, improved consistency, and better customer and revenue outcomes.
  • Turn operational data into actionable insights for leadership, helping the organization prioritize the right interventions, investments, and process changes.
  • Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc KPI analysis for senior leadership.

Team Leadership & Change Management

  • Build a high-performing Operations function that combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor, systems fluency, and practical execution.
  • Coach and enable others on process discipline, systems thinking, and effective use of AI and automation.
  • Lead change management for new workflows, tools, reporting structures, and operating standards across the customer organization and its key partnerships with Marketing.
  • Create strong adoption plans so process and tooling improvements are actually used in the field, not just launched.
  • Lead by example with a balance of strategic leadership and hands-on problem solving.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Operations, Customer Success Operations, Marketing Operations, Support Operations, Services Operations, or a closely related function within a SaaS or technology company.
  • 4+ years of experience leading teams, major cross-functional initiatives, or both.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling operational systems across multiple customer-facing or go-to-market functions, not just one department.
  • Strong experience with platforms such as Gainsight, Salesforce, Jira, Glean, ThoughtSpot, Clay, BI/reporting tools, and workflow automation systems.
  • Proven ability to design and improve complex processes that span data, people, and technology.
  • Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases in business operations, with sound judgment about risk, controls, and where human review is required.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to move from messy operating reality to clear structure, measurable metrics, and scalable execution.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Strong project and program management discipline with the ability to prioritize competing demands and keep high-impact initiatives moving.
  • A hands-on operating style. This role is for a leader who can shape strategy and also get deep into the systems, workflows, and details required to make the strategy real.
  • Experience in fintech, regulated industries, or other complex customer environments is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Dentons Business Services EMEA is the operational backbone of Dentons, supporting the world's largest law firm in delivering exceptional service to clients across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As a crucial component of Dentons' global network, our EMEA business services team plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration.

At Dentons Business Services EMEA, we are committed to excellence in supporting legal professionals with cutting-edge solutions. Our dynamic and diverse team collaborates seamlessly to provide a wide range of services, including finance, IT, human resources, marketing, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.

About the opportunity

The legal market is changing quickly, and our clients increasingly expect legal services that are efficient, data-informed and enabled by technology. We now have an exciting opportunity to join our Europe Legal Tech Enablement team as a Legal Engineer. In this role, you will help support the design, configuration, deployment and delivery of practical legal technology solutions, including AI-enabled tools, working closely with lawyers, legal and other stakeholders across Europe.

You will support the Legal Tech Enablement team by:

• Supporting the design, creation, deployment and implementation of internal and client-facing legal technology solutions, with a particular focus on AI-enabled tools, including workflow automation, matter management tools and document automation;

• Assisting with the configuration, testing, improvement and day-to-day operation of legal workflows, AI-enabled solutions, online questionnaires, automated templates and data extraction processes, including the day-to-day management of different tool instances, across multiple levels, from user access and permissions to operational coordination and communications with technology vendors;

• Helping legal teams adopt technology and AI solutions in a practical, responsible and user-friendly way, with guidance from more experienced Legal Engineers and senior stakeholders;

• Supporting eDiscovery, litigation support and technology-assisted review projects, including project set-up, coordination, tracking and operational delivery.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at an early stage of their legal technology career who is curious, organized and excited by the opportunity to work at the intersection of law, AI and technology. The role offers hands-on, delivery-focused experience, with opportunities to develop expertise in legal engineering, eDiscovery, automation and AI-enabled solutions, while developing practical project management skills within an international law firm environment.

Responsibilities:

• Support the delivery of legal engineering projects across Europe, including AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, transaction management, litigation case management, compliance matters and document automation;

• Assist with requirements gathering, process mapping and documentation of legal workflows, helping translate legal working and business needs into clear requirements for technology, automation and AI-enabled solutions under the guidance of Legal Engineers and senior team members;

• Create and maintain automated templates, online questionnaires, simple workflow configurations and AI-supported use cases using the Firm’s approved legal technology platforms;

• Test automated documents, workflows, AI-enabled tools and technology-enabled processes, record issues clearly, support troubleshooting and help implement fixes or enhancements;

• Support eDiscovery projects from initiation to close, including matter intake, scoping support, project planning, tracker preparation, status reporting and coordination with legal teams, clients, vendors and internal technology teams;

• Coordinate day-to-day eDiscovery project activity, including tracking deadlines, monitoring review progress, escalating risks, maintaining project documentation and supporting delivery of review outputs;

• Provide operational support for technology-assisted review, AI-supported data extraction, litigation support and other efficiency projects across Europe;

• Prepare user guides, training materials, project notes and other documentation to support adoption and knowledge sharing;

• Help run user testing, gather feedback and support continuous improvement of deployed solutions, AI use cases and project processes.

Requirements

• This role might suit a junior lawyer, paralegal, legal operations professional, legal technologist, litigation support analyst or recent graduate who is curious about how AI and technology are transforming legal service delivery and process improvement, with a strong interest in law;

• A degree or qualification in law, technology, engineering, information management, legal operations or a related discipline would be beneficial;

• Some experience in a law firm, legal department, professional services environment, litigation support, eDiscovery or legal operations would be helpful, but we are open to candidates with the right aptitude and learning mindset;

• Interest in legal technology tools such as legal AI, document automation, workflow automation, eDiscovery platforms, technology-assisted review, data extraction or matter management solutions;

• Ability to understand legal processes, follow structured workflows and translate user needs into clear requirements or project tasks;

• Strong attention to detail, organization and follow-through, particularly when supporting projects with multiple stakeholders, deadlines and moving parts;

• Good communication skills, including the ability to explain issues clearly, ask thoughtful questions and keep project stakeholders informed;

• Proactive, collaborative and comfortable learning new tools, working with data and supporting practical, responsible and user-friendly technology-enabled solutions;

• Ability to work both as part of a team and independently, with appropriate supervision, and to prioritize tasks under pressure.

Benefits

  • Remuneration and benefits package will reflect the successful candidates experience and country where hired.

React Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: React Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced React Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern enterprise web applications that power customer-facing digital platforms, internal business portals, and cloud-native SaaS solutions. This role focuses on building highly responsive, scalable, and maintainable Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React while integrating seamlessly with enterprise APIs, cloud services, and microservices-based backend platforms.
You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, cloud architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences across large-scale enterprise applications. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, a passion for clean architecture, and experience building production applications that serve thousands of concurrent users.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React and TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components following enterprise design system standards.
  • Develop responsive web applications optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
  • Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and cloud-native backend platforms.
  • Collaborate with UX designers to convert Figma or Adobe XD designs into pixel-perfect, accessible user interfaces.
  • Implement efficient client-side state management using Redux Toolkit, React Query, Zustand, or Context API.
  • Optimize application performance through lazy loading, code splitting, memoization, virtualization, and efficient rendering strategies.
  • Build secure authentication and authorization workflows using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Azure Active Directory, Okta, or Auth0.
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, SignalR, or Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  • Develop reusable custom hooks, utility libraries, and shared component packages.
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure application reliability and maintainability.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, browser compatibility challenges, and front-end performance bottlenecks.
  • Work closely with DevOps teams to automate deployments through CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional front-end software development experience.
  • Four or more years of hands-on React development experience building enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React 18+, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Hooks, Functional Components, Context API, Suspense, Error Boundaries, and component lifecycle.
  • Experience implementing state management using Redux Toolkit, Redux, Zustand, React Query (TanStack Query), or Context API.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
  • Experience working with authentication technologies including JWT, OAuth2, Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or OpenID Connect.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with modern front-end build tools including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, and Yarn.
  • Experience working with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience using CI/CD platforms including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and browser profiling tools.
  • Experience consuming backend services built with .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS platforms supporting thousands of concurrent users.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).
  • Experience implementing Micro Frontend architecture using Module Federation.
  • Knowledge of Progressive Web Applications (PWA) and offline-first web applications.
  • Experience integrating real-time communication using SignalR, WebSockets, or Firebase.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI (Swagger), GraphQL, Apollo Client, and API Gateway integrations.
  • Experience developing reusable enterprise component libraries and design systems.
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry, application monitoring, and front-end observability tools.

Project Environment
You will be joining a digital engineering team responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and delivering cloud-native customer experiences. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise customer self-service portals
  • Financial services dashboards and transaction platforms
  • Healthcare provider and patient engagement applications
  • Insurance policy management and claims processing systems
  • Real-time operational analytics and executive dashboards

Senior/Principal Medical Writer – Remote/Hybrid - Portugal

Trilogy Writing & Consulting, An Indegene Company, is currently looking to hire Senior/Principal Medical Writers (f/w/d) to support our growing company in producing high-quality regulatory documentation for the international pharmaceutical industry. At Trilogy, you will be part of a team that provides a service that goes beyond just writing. Our writers are integral parts of clinical development teams supporting the writing and coordination of successful documentation across a broad spectrum of therapeutic areas. As a growing company, there is room to develop with us… and your ideas will form our future together.

Applicants must live in one of the following countries: The UK, Germany, Italy, Ireland, or Portugal. 

As a Senior/Principal Medical Writer you will:

  • Prepare a variety of clinical regulatory documents (Clinical Study Protocols, Clinical Study Reports, Clinical Summaries in the CTD format, Investigator Brochures, IMPDs/INDs, scientific publications) as the lead writer in collaboration with members of client authoring teams and supported by other writers, as appropriate.
  • Ensure that all documents are produced according to agreed timelines, monitor and manage project budgets, adhere to relevant SOPs, and meet the requirements of Trilogy as well as the company’s clients.
  • Be responsible for providing document-specific advice to clients.
  • Oversee and coordinate other writers and QC specialists assisting on documents under your responsibility.
  • Project manage the timelines and review cycles of your documents.
  • Work in the client’s regulatory document management systems.

The candidate must have the following writing experience:

  • Several years of professional experience actively writing regulatory documents.
  • Worked as the lead writer on >3 (Senior Medical Writer) or >5 (Principal Medical Writer) of at least 3 of the following: Clinical Study Protocols, Clinical Study Reports, Clinical Summaries in the CTD format, Investigator Brochures, IMPDs/INDs, scientific publications.
  • For the Principal Medical Writer level, experience in at least 2 different types of CTD dossiers (i.e. full new chemical entity application, a variation, a generic dossier, an orphan drug dossier, a literature-based dossier [e.g. a full-mixed application under Article 8(3) of Directive 2001/83/EC]).
  • Experience interacting directly with clients or authors of the documents and coordinating review cycles, meetings, and project timelines.
  • For the Principal Medical Writer level, ability and willingness to take on any project for which a Lead Writer is needed.
  • Competency in the use of document management systems and review tools.

In addition to having the above writing experience, applicants must have:

  • Diploma/Masters/Bachelor’s degree in science/pharmacy (Ph.D. not necessary).
  • Fluent written and spoken English skills.
  • An appreciation for a well-written document and an eye for details.
  • Excellent, proven interpersonal skills and enjoy proactively participating on a team with diverse personalities.
  • Flexibility and the ability to stay focused under tight timelines.
  • Must live in the UK, Germany, Italy, Ireland, or Portugal.

Remuneration will be relative to the level of experience, with all standard Trilogy benefits.

Only candidates who meet the following requirements will be considered:

  • Applicants will work fully remotely. Freelancers need not apply.
  • Submission of documents in English.
  • Cover letter specifying how you comply with the experience requirements listed above.
  • CV

We passionately believe in creating a supportive environment in which everyone can grow, flourish, and do their best work.
